title: Data model for a Biocorner secondary raw material
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a secondary raw material (SRM) used in Biocorner bio-based mortar formulations, covering its origin category, chemical composition, density and the pretreatment and storage it requires.

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT code of the unit of measurement of the value.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:SRM:<id>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be SRM

name.description: Property. Common name of the secondary raw material as used in the construction and bio-materials research community.

description.description: Property. General description of the material including biological or industrial origin, geographic provenance, and primary intended use in construction applications.

category.description: Property. Classification of the secondary raw material by origin: Marine Biomass, Agricultural Biomass, or Industrial By-product. Enables supply chain analysis by waste stream type.

chemicalComposition.description: Property. Primary chemical constituents and their typical percentage ranges. Includes key oxides, organic fractions, and trace elements relevant to product performance.

density.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KMQ. Bulk density of the material in its delivery condition. Critical parameter for mix design calculations and storage dimensioning.

pretreatmentRequired.description: Property. Physical, thermal, or chemical processing steps required before the material can be incorporated into a product formulation. Includes target parameters for each step.

storageConditions.description: Property. Required storage environment to preserve material quality, including temperature, humidity, ventilation, and contamination prevention requirements.
